title: Jesus didn’t rebuke the pagans.
paragraphs:
Jesus didn’t rebuke the pagans.
He rebuked the lukewarm believers.
In the Book of Revelation, Christ spoke a chilling warning to the church:
“I know your works: you are neither cold nor hot… So because you are lukewarm… I will spit you out of my mouth.” — Revelation 3:15–16

The danger was not hatred of God.
The danger was comfortable Christianity.

Faith without surrender.
Worship without obedience.
Religion without transformation.
The world expects the church to look like the world.
But Jesus calls His people to burn with devotion, not blend into compromise.

Not cold.
Not hot.
Just comfortable.
And Christ says that condition is the most dangerous of all.
If Jesus examined your faith today… would He find fire or lukewarm comfort?
Why do you think lukewarm faith is so dangerous in the church today?
“Lukewarm faith doesn’t openly reject Jesus — it slowly replaces Him with comfort.”
